I'm sorry if this is the wrong subverse to post this in, but I didn't have any luck finding one better suited for this question. Thank you for taking the time to read this.
What Percent of People Get Their Wisdom Teeth After 30?

The only thing I could find was a study that discusses pathology associated with the presence and removal of third molars (wisdom teeth). The overall impression I get from the paper is that it is possible that your wisdom teeth could come in later in life but the likelihood of this happening was unclear. The American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons take seems to be that earlier removal is better for overall health.

AAOMS.org

You're very likely to not get them, as most get theirs at 15-25. However I have heard of them showing up as late as age 50. Not trying to freak you out as those cases are outliers, I suggest not worrying about it, you'll likely be fine.
